description: This PHP file defines the class 'History' which implements the 'HistoryInterface'. It manages history files related to view layouts in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including functionalities like adding, retrieving, restoring, and managing the history of layout files with timestamped filenames.

classes.name: History
classes.description: A class managing historical layout files for the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, supporting operations like add, retrieve, restore, and cleanup based on timestamped filenames.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the History object, sets the preview filename, loads existing history files, and sorts them.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of history entries.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the most recent timestamp in the history list.

methods.name: getLast
methods.description: Returns the oldest timestamp in the history list.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next older timestamp in the history list.

methods.name: getNth
methods.description: Returns the timestamp at a specified index in the history list.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new layout file to the history, assigning a unique timestamped filename, copying the file, and maintaining history limit.

methods.name: restoreByTimestamp
methods.description: Restores a layout file from history based on a given timestamp.

methods.name: undoRestore
methods.description: Deletes the current preview layout file, effectively undoing the last restore.

methods.name: getFileByTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the full file path for a history file corresponding to a specific timestamp.
